name: --dangerously-bypass-hook-trust
description: Run enabled hooks without requiring persisted hook trust for this invocation.

examples.explanation: Use only in automation that has already vetted every enabled hook source.

when_to_use: Use only in controlled automation where hook sources are already trusted externally.
when_not_to_use: Do not use for ordinary local development or with unreviewed hooks.

conditions: Intended for automation that already vets hook sources.

name: --strict-config
description: Error when config.toml contains fields that this Codex version does not recognize.

examples.explanation: Fail fast in CI when configuration contains an unsupported field.

when_to_use: Validate configuration compatibility during upgrades or automated runs.

conditions: Supported by documented runtime commands including codex, exec, review, resume, fork, app-server, mcp-server, and exec-server.

name: --bundled
description: Skip refreshing the model catalog and print only the catalog bundled with the current Codex binary.

examples.explanation: Inspect only models shipped with the current installation.

name: --download-url
description: Override the ChatGPT desktop app installer URL used by codex app when installation is required.

examples.explanation: Use a controlled installer endpoint during desktop-app setup.

conditions: Advanced override for codex app installation.
